newsitem.title: USA: GeneMedicine stake raised by investor.
newsitem.headline: GeneMedicine stake raised by investor.

text.p: Investor David Blech said Tuesday he raised his stake in GeneMedicine Inc to 914,833 common shares or seven percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Blech said his latest transactions include the purchase of 274,500 common shares between February 7 and April 4 at prices ranging from $6.28 to $9.25 per share.
GeneMedicine, based in Houston, Texas, researches and develops a new class of pharmaceutical products, called gene medicines, that incorporate genes.
